entry.title: New: Resolution 553 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 553-26 - 05/05/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR ONE MULTIFUNCTION COPY MACHINE TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an estimated annual cost of $2,336.76, to be used by the department’s Building Division in Hilo.
